scope: Research coverage and explicit evidence limits for all 150 current requirements; not certification of implementation or exhaustive empirical knowledge.

topics.application: Reuse verified algorithms and fixtures; replace authority contracts; preserve and semantically incorporate every original source element.
topics.evidence_limit: Local source probes and inventories do not establish completed Beta import; classic reconstructions are not official full source releases.

topics.application: Measure coherent careers/adventure and repeatable accepted-content throughput rather than feature counts.
topics.evidence_limit: Reference success and player reports do not establish Beta fun, staffing or a release date.

topics.application: One state owner, language-neutral contracts, bounded deterministic work and lossless lived-history preservation.
topics.evidence_limit: Language/platform documentation and local code are evidence of mechanisms; target performance and exports remain unrun.

topics.application: Separate generation, persistent authority and residency; qualify four spread players and all vehicle speeds against meaningful discovery.
topics.evidence_limit: NMS full proprietary pipeline was not inspected; the 2017 talk listing is explicitly limited evidence.

topics.application: Causal lineages and environments, scoped beliefs and concrete divine effects; culture, ancestry and individual ethics remain distinct.
topics.evidence_limit: No reference proves a complete cosmic/species/divine simulation; Beta composition is an original design inference.

topics.topic: Actor parity, classes and party capabilities
topics.application: Share applicable state and legal actions across controllers; keep class, profession and office distinct.
topics.evidence_limit: Reference actor structures support lessons, not full player-equivalent city-scale proof.

topics.application: Separate rule literacy, acquired observations and advanced controls; basic risk/accessibility remain legible.
topics.evidence_limit: Player preference evidence is self-selected and cannot choose Beta interface complexity without testing.

topics.application: Typed transformations, conservation, bounded composition, practical professions and consequences in quests/puzzles.
topics.evidence_limit: No reference proves arbitrary prose magic or every imaginable profession; named production families require explicit implementation.

topics.topic: Daily survival, domestic life and rest
topics.application: Long days, meaningful care/work, manageable upkeep and multiplayer consent; accelerated time remains a rule.
topics.evidence_limit: Forty minutes is an initial tuning target; subjective pace and isolated-rest UX require actual play.

topics.application: Validate realized geometry and logical opportunities; use layered history, actual occupants, real stacked terrain and institutions.
topics.evidence_limit: Graph loops are not proof of interesting layouts; 20,000 residents is a qualification candidate, not measured capacity.

topics.application: News and material effects change real choices; sparse persistent relationships, mandates and lifecycle custody support independent outcomes.
topics.evidence_limit: Complex society can generate opaque stories; causal correctness alone does not establish emotional engagement.

topics.application: Actual stock and cargo, local prices, route costs, escort work and alternative supply paths begin early.
topics.evidence_limit: Economic stability and enjoyable arbitrage need long runs; reference feedback is not a calibrated Beta price model.

topics.application: Compose events from shared participants, combat/action rules, schedules, built spaces, entry conditions, rewards and reputation.
topics.retained_proofs: P07/P09 competition catalog and composite DC; SYN-12
topics.evidence_limit: No inspected reference supplies a full transferable arena economy; this is an explicit original composition to validate, not a researched implementation guarantee.

topics.application: Arbitrary requested historical instants, stable refinement, branch custody and dream tether; temporal progression includes knowledge and schedules.
topics.evidence_limit: Any-instant historical society exceeds the inspected reference evidence; fidelity, storage and restoration require early proofs.

topics.application: First-party typed extension surfaces, validation and pinned versions; creators reuse actual runtime capabilities; preserve historical dependencies.
topics.evidence_limit: Package loading is not a sandbox or proof of arbitrary extension coverage; broader online systems are future architecture commitments.

topics.application: Providers return scoped typed proposals; accepted results persist and replay offline.
topics.evidence_limit: No model quality or determinism follows from seed reuse; there is no measured model comparison in this specification pass.

topics.application: Wait decisions and on-field staging with explicit local stasis for independent co-op; desktop first, mobile retained phase.
topics.evidence_limit: Classic single-player Wait does not prove split-party chronology; native/mobile device behavior remains unrun.

topics.application: Interchangeable leads, separate artists, bounded maintenance, independent critics and real-build playtests; persist only reusable guidance.
topics.evidence_limit: Skill integrity and workflow design are verified separately from model productivity; no current MCP capability is inferred from an inventory.

topics.application: Separate Sea of Stars finish and Stardew-like responsive interaction; native family coverage, restrained material history and semantic choreography.
topics.evidence_limit: Accepted still direction is not accepted pixel scale, animation, production assets or actual scene performance.

topics.application: Curated grammars bind real participants; motives, evidence and changing outcomes support coherent independent arcs and mysteries.
topics.evidence_limit: Destroyed evidence can leave a truthful cold case; a coherent seed is not proof of a uniformly compelling campaign.

topics.topic: Vehicles, mounts, pets and familiar care
topics.application: Companions remain actors; vehicles remain part assemblies with real cargo/crew/care and transport-specific constraints.
topics.evidence_limit: Named fantastical vehicle combinations are Beta designs; supported speeds and native body coverage need qualification.

topics.application: Separate hardness, support, flow, wear and appearance; conserve materials and record time/event causes.
topics.evidence_limit: Material simulation and visual variant cost remain engineering/production proofs.

topics.application: Constructive supported-start progression witnesses; vector difficulty across capability, knowledge, resources and time; alternate solutions and harder optional gates.
topics.evidence_limit: No scalar DC or finite seed sweep guarantees every future altered world remains solvable.

topics.application: Rare serious losses with anatomy/action changes and reliable declared restoration; scars more common, campaign incidence matters.
topics.evidence_limit: Injury frequency is an owner-directed tuning goal; no reference-derived percentage is adopted without campaign testing.

topics.application: Shared facts and legal actions connect every domain; selected pair/triple coverage challenges dangerous combinations.
topics.evidence_limit: The interaction space is not exhaustively enumerable; coverage is explicit, risk-based and refined from actual failures.
